hero.title: Your dental care,
hero.subtitle: Sinan connects patients with dentists, and gives clinics everything they need to run — bookings, records, and payments, in one calm place.

about.title: One platform for
about.body: Sinan is a Lebanese dental platform. Patients find the right dentist and book in seconds; clinics get a modern system that handles the whole day — no paper, no chaos, no lost files.
about.v1Body: Real reviews from real visits, and health records protected clinic by clinic.
about.v2Body: Your medical history and dental chart are yours — shared only with the dentists you choose.
about.v3Body: Book, confirm, remind, collect — everything moves in a tap.

patients.title: Find your dentist. Book in seconds.
patients.subtitle: Everything you need to take care of your teeth, in one app.
patients.p1Body: Browse trusted dentists near you, filter by area, and see real ratings.
patients.p2Body: Pick a time that suits you and send a request — the clinic confirms it.
patients.p3Body: See the exact dental chart your dentist drew — your health, in your hand.
patients.p4Body: Your medical history follows you to every clinic you choose to visit.
patients.p5Body: A gentle nudge before each appointment so you never miss one.
patients.p6Body: Share an honest review after each visit and help others choose well.

doctors.title: Run your whole clinic from one screen.
doctors.subtitle: Sinan gives your clinic a modern engine — and puts you in front of new patients.
doctors.d1Body: Every appointment, walk-in and overbook in one clean day view.
doctors.d2Body: History, notes, treatment plans and payments — one file per patient.
doctors.d3Body: Income, expenses, balances and installments, tracked automatically.
doctors.d4Body: Follow every case out at the lab, from sent to seated.
doctors.d5Body: A precise, tap-to-edit dental chart your patients can see too.
doctors.d6Body: Appear in the marketplace and accept bookings from the app.

how.title: Getting started is simple.
how.s1Body: Leave your clinic's details — name, area, and how to reach you.
how.s2Body: Our team calls within a day, agrees the plan, and creates your account.
how.s3Body: Start booking, charting and collecting the same day.

packages.title: Pick what your clinic needs.
packages.subtitle: Simple plans that grow with you — pay only for what you use.
packages.note: Final pricing is agreed on a quick call — no card needed to start.
packages.none: Plans coming soon — contact us to get started.

join.title: Ready to join Sinan?
join.subtitle: Leave your details and our team will reach out within 24 hours to set your clinic up.
